_comment: The fixed-point decode tier's PCM hashes (planning/arithmetic-tiers.md): FNV-1a over every sample the bare-metal probe delivers for each fixture, as <codec>.pcm_hash prints them. Integer arithmetic, so the same on every platform by construction; measured 2026-09-10 on the x86 host and the Cortex-M3 leg, identical. Re-pin when the tier's arithmetic changes on purpose (tools/checks/check_probe_hashes.py --expected).
